page_title: PAL 1-2 GET | Las Palmas v Getafe 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Javier Alberola is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

90+6' A neat pass is well received by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.
90+3' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria is equal to it and makes an easy save.
90+2' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Alex Sola (Getafe) replaces Coba Gomez da Costa.
88' 1 - 2 Goal! Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the roof of the net. It's 1:2.
87' Javier Munoz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas).
86' 0 - 2 It's 0:2! Coba Gomez da Costa feeds Borja Mayoral (Getafe) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
84' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
82' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card.
82' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
81' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
80' Sandro Ramirez goes off the pitch and Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) comes on.
80' Here is a change. Dario Essugo is going off and Diego Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
80' Today's match ends for Fabio Silva who will be replaced by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
79' Peter Federico (Getafe) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but the effort goes just wide of the right post.
79' Javier Alberola blows the whistle, Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is penalised for a foul. Getafe earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
78' Luis Milla (Getafe) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
78' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Getafe.
70' 0 - 1 GOAL! Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) scores with a header from close range after Christantus Uche headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 0:1.
66' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

66' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Las Palmas earn a corner.
66' Fouls committed – 10:15.
64' Luis Milla (Getafe) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bertug Yildirim trots off the pitch and is replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
63' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Peter Federico (Getafe) replacing Carles Alena.
61' What a sweet touch by Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for David Soria to hold.

56' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. David Soria anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
55' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

55' Omar Alderete (Getafe) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Las Palmas are awarded a penalty.
53' One of the players from Getafe times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
53' Luis Milla finds the head of Domingos Duarte (Getafe) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies past the left post. Unlucky!
53' A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.
50' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Diego Martinez makes a half-time substitution. Manuel Fuster comes on in place of Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Javier Alberola blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Getafe was in an offside position.
45+1' It seemed like Luis Milla (Getafe) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Getafe are awarded a free kick.
45' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
42' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
42' Javier Alberola has a clear sight and sees a foul from Domingos Duarte (Getafe).
41' Christantus Uche (Getafe) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
40' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
38' Luis Milla (Getafe) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Alberola blows for a foul.

32' A neat pass finds Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom right corner, but David Soria denies him with a good save.
31' Javier Alberola interrupts the game. One of the players from Getafe won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
29' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

29' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Getafe.
26' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Getafe win a corner.
25' Las Palmas are ruled offside.
21' A clever short pass gives Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
21' Las Palmas seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
17' The free kick from long range, taken by Las Palmas, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola had an easy-decision to make.
15' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
13' Christantus Uche (Getafe) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
12' What a chance that is! Carles Alena (Getafe) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
11' Luis Milla (Getafe) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
10' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
6' Javier Alberola blows his whistle after Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to Getafe, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
3' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Fabio Silva, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
2' The Las Palmas players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
Javier Alberola got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
